name: Synthetic Hospital Wayfinding Benchmark
description: Analysis-ready data and dependency-free verification code supporting a comparative methodological evaluation of a synthetic benchmark for hospital wayfinding search. The package contains 563 compact review outcomes, 434 retained synthetic queries, frozen per-query system ranks and response indicators, full-precision baseline scores, robustness outcomes, exploratory LLM outcomes, latency evidence, and expected manuscript values. It reproduces the reported aggregate statistics but does not include or rerun institution-specific search indexes, credentials, production prompts, model files, or raw LLM responses. All query text is synthetic. No patient data, patient query logs, medical records, patient-specific information, Matterport identifiers, credentials, or operational destination identifiers are included.
